highlights: Cutting-edge 4G network – share internet access with up to 64 Wi-Fi devices and enjoy download speeds of up to 150 Mbps
AC1200 Wi-Fi – creates simultaneous dual band Wi-Fi networks, with maximum speeds of up to 300 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz band and 867 Mbps on the 5 GHz band
Plug a SIM card and play – no configurations needed, compatibility for SIM cards in 100+ countries are assured by years of field tests
Two detachable advanced LTE antennas – enjoy stable and efficient connections to every device thanks to the two external antennas
Wi-Fi router mode – plug an Ethernet cable into the LAN/WAN port for flexible access if you can't get a 4G connection
Button    WPS/RESET Button, Wi-Fi ON/OFF Button
Wireless Standards    IEEE 802.11a/n/ac 5 GHz, IEEE 802.11b/g/n 2.4 GHz
